content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We must use templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. So first step (most recent retrosynthesis) uses template 1914393 to break target into precursors. Then second step uses 1914394 on one of the precursors, then third step uses 1914395 on resulting precursor.

We need to construct JSON tree: root is molecule target, children is reaction node with template_id 1914393, its children are precursor molecules (type mol). Then for each precursor that still needs further disconnection, we add reaction nodes as children of that mol? The format example shows reaction node under root, then children are mols (reactants). For multi-step, we need nested children: each precursor that is further broken will have its own reaction node as child.

Thus we need to apply templates to see what precursors they generate. Use apply_template tool.

First apply template 1914393 to target SMILES.
